title: Home that climbs the pile: the colony builds a food tower over its door
question: I tried making home follow whatever piles up on the nest mouth (so the colony's own food cannot bury it). Every lab colony stacked crumbs into a tower instead. I am reverting it and keeping the plain mouth. Anything here you want kept?
context_md:
Lab box, same seeds and stops for both. **Left**: home is the dug mouth (door + 6-row shaft). **Right**: home is the mouth *and* any unbroken pile over it (`NEST_HOME=mound`). Crumbs do not slide, and ants put food down only at home, so every delivery raises home by up to a cell.

The first image is seed 7 at five stops (6,300 / 12,600 / 30,600 / 60,300 / 119,700). The sheets are all 12 seeds at 12,600 / 30,600 / 60,300. Nothing here ships: both switches are off by default.

items.label: seed 7, mouth (left) vs mound (right)
